post_clip.description: Individual in hooded sweatshirt and gloves ascends stairs cautiously, then abruptly ducks, covers head with arms, and moves rapidly away—behavior consistent with reacting to sudden threat (e.g., gunfire), though no weapon or impact visible. No other persons present; no clear alternative explanation (e.g., falling object) evident in frames.

At frame 7, the individual suddenly extends their arm forward and a bright flash/spark erupts from their hand, consistent with muzzle flash from a firearm discharge. Immediately after (frames 8–10), the person recoils and rapidly moves away down the stairs, exhibiting evasive behavior typical after firing a weapon. No other person is visible, but the sudden flash and abrupt departure strongly indicate a shooting event.
